question: What is the highest eligible free rate for K-12 students in the schools in Alameda County?

question: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.
evidence: Difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment can be computed by `Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
golden_sql: SELECT T2.School, T2.DOC FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm AS T3 INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded')
generated_sql:
WITH avg_diff AS (
  SELECT AVG(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS avg_difference
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
    AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
CROSS JOIN avg_diff
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
  AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > avg_diff.avg_difference
ORDER BY (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") DESC;

question: Under whose administration is the school with the highest number of students scoring 1500 or more on the SAT? Indicate their full names.
evidence: full name means first name, last name; There are at most 3 administrators for each school; SAT Scores are greater or equal to 1500 refers to NumGE1500
golden_sql: SELECT T2.AdmFName1, T2.AdmLName1, T2.AdmFName2, T2.AdmLName2, T2.AdmFName3, T2.AdmLName3 FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
generated_sql:
WITH top_school AS (
  SELECT cds
  FROM satscores
  WHERE NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT TRIM(s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1) AS full_name
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND s.AdmLName1 IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT TRIM(s.AdmFName2 || ' ' || s.AdmLName2) AS full_name
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND s.AdmLName2 IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT TRIM(s.AdmFName3 || ' ' || s.AdmLName3) AS full_name
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND s.AdmLName3 IS NOT NULL;

question: What is the complete address of the school with the lowest excellence rate? Indicate the Street, City, Zip and State.
evidence: Execellence Rate = NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr; complete address has Street, City, State, Zip code
golden_sql: SELECT T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T1.NumTstTakr ASC LIMIT 1
generated_sql:
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT
    cds,
    (NumGE1500 * 1.0) / NumTstTakr AS excellence_rate
  FROM satscores
  WHERE NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL AND NumTstTakr IS NOT NULL AND NumTstTakr > 0
)
SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM rates r
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = r.cds
WHERE s.Street IS NOT NULL AND s.City IS NOT NULL AND s.Zip IS NOT NULL AND s.State IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY r.excellence_rate ASC, s.CDSCode ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which schools served a grade span of Kindergarten to 9th grade in the county of Los Angeles and what is its Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)?

question: What are the two most common first names among the school administrators? Indicate the district to which they administer.
golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.AdmFName1, T1.District FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT admfname1 FROM schools GROUP BY admfname1 ORDER BY COUNT(admfname1) DESC LIMIT 2 ) AS T2 ON T1.AdmFName1 = T2.admfname1

  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.District,
    TRIM(CASE WHEN instr(s.AdmFName1, '(') > 0 THEN substr(s.AdmFName1, 1, instr(s.AdmFName1, '(') - 1) ELSE s.AdmFName1 END) AS first_name
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.AdmFName1) <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.District,
    TRIM(CASE WHEN instr(s.AdmFName2, '(') > 0 THEN substr(s.AdmFName2, 1, instr(s.AdmFName2, '(') - 1) ELSE s.AdmFName2 END) AS first_name
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.AdmFName2) <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.District,
    TRIM(CASE WHEN instr(s.AdmFName3, '(') > 0 THEN substr(s.AdmFName3, 1, instr(s.AdmFName3, '(') - 1) ELSE s.AdmFName3 END) AS first_name
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.AdmFName3) <> ''

name_counts AS (

  FROM admins
  WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(first_name) <> ''
  GROUP BY name_key
  ORDER BY total_cnt DESC
